nodes.label: Structured logging via core.Log (recover boundaries)
nodes.rationale: Every recover boundary and reactive warning emits an entry with a stable kind field (recover.event_handler, recover.error_boundary, recover.re_render, signal.cycle, warn); the WASM bridge forwards the payload to goowee.log() which routes to console.error/warn/log by kind.

nodes.label: Dev-mode inspector (goowee.inspect / devtools.Snapshot)
nodes.rationale: Snapshots the mounted component/scope/element tree and registered signals; signals are auto-registered from UseState/UseResource/Computed when devtools are enabled. Enabled via ?goowee-dev or localStorage; bridge.Run enables it when goowee.devEnabled() is true.
